capabilities: Group community plugins into custom folders by keyword matching
Rename plugins with aliases and reorder groups via drag and drop or alphabetical sorting
Add personal notes to plugins and sync them to a standalone markdown file
Toggle, hide, or lock groups of plugins from the configuration menu
Compact the sidebar with collapsible headers, hidden tabs, and a search bar
extras: The README carries a CAUTION warning: it manipulates the settings sidebar DOM directly because there is no official API, so Obsidian UI updates may break it until the plugin is updated; it works by clicking hidden real buttons through proxy buttons.
intentEvidence: Created because I had too many plugins and got lost in the sidebar; feedback welcome!
motivation: The author created it because they had too many plugins and got lost in the sidebar.
problem: Obsidian's settings sidebar lists community plugins as one long flat list that becomes hard to navigate once you have many plugins installed.

relations.evidence: Supports compatibility with other plugins (like Plugin Annotations) by hiding HTML comment wrappers

summary: Settings sidebar organizer that groups community plugins into folders with aliases, custom ordering, notes, and a compacted UI.
